spans.s: मेच मेच, अस्, m., N. of a poet; [cf. मेघ.]

मेचक मेचक, अस्, आ, अम् (said to be fr. rt.
मच्), dark-blue, dark-coloured, black; (अस्), m.
dark-blue colour, black; blackness; an eye of a
peacock's tail; a teat, nipple; smoke; a cloud; Mo-
ringa Pterygosperma; a kind of gem; (अम्), n.
darkness; sulphuret of antimony.
—मेचकापगा
(˚क-अप्˚), f. ‘dark-blue river,’ an epithet of the
Yamunā.
—मेचकाभिधा (˚क-अभ्˚), f. a species
of creeper (= पाताल-गरुडी).

मेचकचातनी मेचकचातनी, f. a various
reading for मचकचातनी, q. v.
मेचुरुदि मेचुरुदि (?), N. of a place.
